title: Classify exact singular polynomial right-vector costs (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped algebraic proof: every singular two-role target over K[t], for every field K, has exact right-vector cost one, two or three, with the following complete classification. Zero has cost two.

```text
M=a b, with a primitive polynomial column;
V=span_K{b1,b2}, d=monic gcd(b1,b2).

cost 1 if a is constant and V contains a nonzero constant;
cost 2 otherwise if a is constant or d belongs to V;
cost 3 otherwise.
```

Paid factors are I+u y^T with y over K. Arbitrary GL2(K) maps are free anywhere. A literal e1,e2,e1 outer-product word attains the upper bound without scratch. The target `[[t,t²+1],[t²,t³+t]]` has exact cost three over every field. This classifies determinant-zero polynomial endpoints, complementing the unbounded invertible costs of #4763/#4784. No new kappa, supplier admission or selected-frontier change.

This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. ToikY #4334 supplies the singular-endpoint gap; Nick Petalas #4276/#4243 supplies the cited exact two-factor criterion and free-map normal form, following Wentao Li #4099 and #2513. The #4780 field-product template is related precedent for the outer-product word. Primitive PID factorization, Bezout and gcd facts are classical. Predecessor results are cited, not audited. Only six files in research/singular-polynomial-cost are added.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19132076).

## Evidence

- Before: #4334 explicitly excludes singular endpoints; #4763/#4784 classify invertible polynomial targets. After: PROOF.md gives the complete singular K[t] theorem, its lower-bound criteria, a three-factor constructor and an all-field sharp example.
- The self-contained standard-library verifier enumerates all 24,066 determinant-zero targets in four bounded domains. Cost-1/2/3 counts are F2 degree<=4: 279/7489/936; F3 degree<=2: 800/5761/0; F4 degree<=1: 975/1201/0; F5 degree<=1: 3024/3601/0. Each includes zero once in cost two. Every primitive factorization, independent constant-chart divisibility comparison and literal three-factor word passes. Every successful two-factor chart is also reconstructed with its free maps and multiplied back to the full target.
- All 35 enumerated boundary and mutation control groups pass. Warning-strict ordinary and optimized direct commands took 2.27 s and 2.26 s locally on CPython 3.12. Their generated receipts agree. Both registered commands pass and are well below their 120-second limits.
- Package metadata/replay, in-memory syntax compilation, staged whitespace checks, committed-byte/source-history preflight, committed export integrity and optimized Git-free export replay pass. The export emits the same complete generated receipt. Receipts bind all six package files by SHA256; no receipt was handwritten.

Exact reproduction from the repository root, with CPython 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B -W error research/singular-polynomial-cost/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -O -B -W error research/singular-polynomial-cost/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/singular-polynomial-cost
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/singular-polynomial-cost --check-source-history
```

Any Python 3.12 interpreter may replace the displayed path. Expected markers are `PASS_SINGULAR_POLYNOMIAL_COST targets=24066 controls=35 no_new_kappa`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

Canonical main was fetched again before submission and remains 624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43, priority revision 7. The formal-interface-lemma card is explicitly changed to this algebraic side result. The card's historical baseline stops at omitted sparse input `research/fresh-helper-thinned/PROOF.md`; no selected scientific replay pass is claimed. Distinctive main README and merged-PR searches, live open PR bodies and recent handoff claims were refreshed before committing. The overlap helper reported complete remote pagination for 326 open PRs and 3,751 Discussion records; sparse local-note coverage was incomplete. Search coverage does not prove novelty.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

The universal claim is the written scoped proof. The finite enumeration corroborates only the displayed fields and degrees. Two roles, one variable and a field of constants are the exact theorem scope. Native coefficient preparation, access, routing, precision, reversible dirty restoration, stock and complete supplier costs remain unknown. No complete multiplication theorem follows. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Lean, Docker and selected operator replay were outside scope and were not run. Every registered package command ran locally.

## Open next questions

- Which singular targets are reachable over the nonprincipal domain K[s²,st,t²]? Start with `[[s²,st],[st,t²]]`, testing outer-product factorization and restricted-right-vector reachability. The one-variable primitive-factorization argument does not supply that step.
- Specify one actual native producer/consumer and price coefficient preparation, ownership, overwrites, restoration, precision and the complete paid list before using these formal words in a supplier. Unknown costs are not zero.

## Related open work

- #4784, head 4d0a6363fe4f45dd9a769f5b74d02fc5d9061ae3, gives the invertible polynomial degree/cost distribution over F_q[t]. Its endpoints are invertible; every endpoint here is singular. No target census or cost distribution overlaps.
- #4781, head b838121c65e1bfd17a65466c95940eb00f12a225, counts singular local residue lifts. At Q=q,z=1, its one-factor count is (q+1)(q²-1). Fresh enumeration of our constant-polynomial nonzero rank-one boundary gives 9,32,75,144 for q=2,3,4,5, agreeing numerically. Its proper-extension lift domain differs from the positive-degree polynomial targets here.
- #4787, head 4b58e8cd5690bd35cf01b0018eefa2c39a298920, gives arbitrary-role invertible local-algebra costs. Both its invertible endpoint contract and local coefficient hypothesis differ; no singular polynomial target count overlaps.
- #4789, head 7fdbf8040ea9a957af0576067df2d9cb6fcf0e51, classifies ordinary rank-two targets over full matrix algebras M_m(K), m>=3. The coefficient algebra differs, and no target-cost census overlaps.
- #4776, head 0764ab259a8ce496a4c5d4debeed4c4e4d9f7ca4, classifies zero-residue pencils over a two-generator square-zero local algebra. Those coefficients differ from K[t]; its pencil count and our polynomial census have no shared numerical domain.
- #4804, head da6f858f21d407648a711d8fd369c37a9c6df24e, handles residue-corank-one local targets at arbitrary role count. K[t] is nonlocal. On the scalar-field two-role boundary, all 9,32,75,144 nonzero rank-one matrices at q=2,3,4,5 have cost one here, agreeing with its delta-one theorem; its reported larger-role sample is distinct and is not replayed.

### Related open work refresh before DONE

This account's open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-10-22T20:16:15Z were listed again: #4801, #4803, #4804, #4805, #4806, #4807, #4808, #4809 and #4810. All same-alphabet titles and bodies were read. #4804 is compared above. The additional related work is:

- #4805, head fbf2bd033f2d3ae1605a3cad690e1fc2fbf477e7, proves three-factor sufficiency for every two-role full-matrix-algebra target. Its coefficients differ from K[t]. At the shared scalar-block boundary m=1, fresh enumeration gives exact cost one for all 9,32,75,144 nonzero rank-one constants over F2,F3,F4,F5 and cost two for zero. These agree numerically with its upper bound of three; its full-matrix census and our positive-degree polynomial census are distinct.
- #4809, head 6354da68f7a78b9e4db91c796476ae9ebae89a86, counts 9,216 invertible two-role targets over F3^4 needing three factors. Its field-product coefficient algebra and invertible endpoints differ from our singular polynomial targets. No target population or degree-conditioned count overlaps.
- #4810, head 701cb14b7c461253d7ac8243d0722996918bc6c6, proves the sharp uniform bound five for invertible three-role binary field-product targets. Both role count and endpoint contract differ. Its 168 group components and our 24,066 singular polynomial targets count different objects; no numerical population overlaps.

The other newly open PRs study Schur spectra, Schur-product counts or full-guard probabilities. They do not compute this singular polynomial factor cost. No disagreement was found in the shared constant-matrix boundary checks. No predecessor verifier was replayed.

Run metadata confirms that exact head and conclusion `success`. The replay executes both warning-strict ordinary and optimized commands. All registered local checks, committed-byte/source-history preflight, export integrity and Git-free replay also passed. Hosted CI certifies execution of the registered bounded checks; independent human and formal proof-kernel acceptance of the universal proof remain unclaimed.
